body.name: Hthr
body.construction: Source-preserving threshold-extension handle on normalized nonnegative tables: for \((c,d)\in F(A,B)\), set \((n_{00},n_{01},n_{10},n_{11})=(c,a-c,b-c,d)\), define \(t_{ij}=n_{ij}/w_{ij}\) when \(w_{ij}>0\) and \(t_{ij}=0\) when \(w_{ij}=0\), define \(\gamma_A=A(1,1)/(1-p)\) when \(1-p>0\) and \(\gamma_A=0\) when \(1-p=0\), and define \(\gamma_B=B(1,1)/(1-r)\) when \(1-r>0\) and \(\gamma_B=0\) when \(1-r=0\).  Use response probability \(t_{uv}\) at \((x,z)=(0,0)\), \(\gamma_A\) at \((x,z)=(1,0)\), \(\gamma_B\) at \((x,z)=(0,1)\), and \(1/2\) at \((x,z)=(1,1)\).  Order the distinct values of these probabilities together with \(0,1\); successive threshold gaps are the atom masses of one private root \(W0\), and threshold indicators define one deterministic map \(fY\) for every regime while \(U0\) and \(V0\) retain their independent source laws.
